------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
For the Petitioner : Mr. H.K. Shikarwar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Achinto Sen, Addl.P.P

For the Informant : Mr. Ranjit Kumar, Adv.
------
Order No.06 Dated- 21.07.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Sadar Mahila P.S. Case No. 03 of 2023 instituted under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner developed intimacy with the informant and on false pretext of marriage, he forcibly committed rape upon the informant.
It is further alleged that the informant gave Rs.1.5 lakh to the petitioner for development of his business but he refused to pay back the same.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
There was consensual sexual relationship between the petitioner and the informant and petitioner is young boy of 24 years having no criminal antecedent.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State assisted by learned counsel for the informant opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that from the very inception, there was fraudulent intention of petitioner to satisfy his own sexual lust in pretext of marriage.
He called the informant at his home in absence of his parents and in spite of her resistance and protest, petitioner committed rape upon her.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: It appears that the informant is young lady of 22 years and she has specifically stated in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.PC that she was ravished by the petitioner without her consent and against her will in false pretext of marriage and she was also duped of Rs.1.5 lakh by the petitioner.

Considering the factual aspects of this case, coupled with materials available on record and direct allegation for commission of serious and heinous offence of rape against the petitioner, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
